Type: shelf
Name: Stone & Beam Rylee Modern Bookcase 27.6"W x 76.8”H, Mixed Gray
Classic style with a modern flair make this bookcase unique. A mixed-gray finish adorns the 4 spacious niches, and the built-in drawer makes for extra storage capacity. The slim profile is ideal for small offices, libraries, and bedrooms. 27.6”W x 13.8”D x 76.8”H Wood Mixed gray finish adds a modern flair to this sturdy wood bookcase Full-size niches and a built-in drawer afford ample space for your collection. No assembly required Avoid moisture. Wipes clean with soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
